description: FOUND s504c.  Repro (/home/bernt/pcl/.claude/worktrees/agent-a41c97e5832f266e1/scratch/s504c/probes/x1.pl + x1d.pl): x1.pl `my $x = "lex"; sub gx { $x } do "./x1d.pl" or die $@; print "gx=", gx(), "\n";`  x1d.pl `$main::x = "glob"; print "d sees main::x=$main::x\n"; 1;`  perl `gx=lex`, PCL (base and s504c) `gx=glob`.  #470 covers the SAME-file spelling only.  s504c's mechanism (mangle with a unit number) would fix it for the program too, at the cost of renaming every program's captured file lexicals (77 distinct identity promotions in the perl-tests sweep alone) -- a corpus-wide emission change and a bench question; needs a ruling.
subject: A PROGRAM`s identity-promoted file lexical IS the package global of that name, so ANOTHER unit writing $main::x (a do-file, a module) overwrites the program`s lexical -- perl gx=lex, PCL gx=glob (the program half of #2633, deliberately left out of s504c: the program unit`s emission had to stay byte-identical)
